scope.candidateMeaning: Best among the four tested +/0 topology candidates in this coupon-plus-fixture model; not a universal cable optimum.
scope.primaryMetric: Minimum worst stored Ethernet differential-voltage magnitude across 10–200 MHz, both pairs, both ends and 8/10/12 ns records.

limits: The 20 mm fanout changes with role placement and is included in the result; cable-only and fanout contributions are not separated.
All pair centers, 24 mm pitches and starting phases are fixed assumptions rather than measured cable lay.
The shield is a floating PEC shell and conductor/dielectric loss is omitted.
No actual 20 m link, connector, transformer, PHY, noise waveform or CRC result is modeled.
